question: Who among the following was one of the two recipients of the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize 2021 in the 'Medical Sciences Category'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Shrivastava**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rohit Shrivastava is a prominent scientist who has made significant contributions in the field of medical sciences.
 
• He was awarded the Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology in 2021, which is one of the highest Indian science awards.
 
• His research primarily focuses on developing innovative medical technologies and solutions.
 
• He has published numerous papers and has been recognized globally for his work in medical sciences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize**

 
 
• It is named after the founder Director of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar.
 
• The prize is awarded annually for notable and outstanding research, applied or fundamental, in various disciplines of science and technology.
 
• It is considered one of the most prestigious science awards in India.
 
• The award consists of a citation, a plaque, and a cash award.
 
 
 
• **Medical Sciences Category**
 
 
• This category includes research in various branches of medical sciences such as clinical, pre-clinical, and translational research.
 
• Medical sciences play a crucial role in improving healthcare, developing new treatments, and understanding human health and diseases.
 
• Research in this field can lead to significant advancements in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Awards in Science and Technology in India**
 
 
• Infosys Prize: Awarded by the Infosys Science Foundation for outstanding achievements in various categories including engineering, computer science, and social sciences.
 
• Padma Awards: Includes Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri, awarded for distinguished contributions in various disciplines including science and technology.
 
• National Science & Technology Awards: Given by various government bodies to recognize contributions in specific fields such as biotechnology, environmental science, and space research.
